messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11: If the event bus is down, the notification service is down: it relies on it for delivery events.
- [2025-06-19] standup/boreal/2025-06-19: As before, webhooks needs the event-bus to work.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2: If the bus is down, the webhooks service is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-04-18] standup/boreal/2025-04-18: Deploys to the event bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-12-29] standup/dune/2025-12-29: Observation from team Dune: after the client rollout, the event-bus' request volume halved.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: Boreal looks after the bus.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01: Heads-up from Boreal: the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2025-08-15] standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2: Team Boreal still owns the bus, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-11-03] standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2: Heads-up from the Boreal team: the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23-2: Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The reporting service is a the Dune team service.
- [2025-03-17] standup/cinder/2025-03-17: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2025-03-26] standup/dune/2025-03-26: Reminder that the reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Observation from team Dune: after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-06-11] handover/2025-06-11-notifier: The notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.

Question: Which service does the event-bus depend on?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: which service does the event-bus depend on?

Let me scan the memory for dependencies of the event-bus. The memory mentions services that depend on the event-bus (notification service, webhooks rely on the event bus), but does the event-bus itself depend on any service?

- Notification service relies on event bus for delivery events.
- Webhooks relies on event bus for outbound events.
- Scheduler needs feature flag service.
- Reporting needs ledger (later switched to bus).
- Billing-api needs Ledger.
- Ledger relies on auth gateway.
- Catalog calls resizer.

Nothing says the event-bus depends on another service. So the answer is "I don't know".
